subject: getData() issues with very big dataset - problem to retrieve the chromosome id

messages.author: 137869ba7a86058b
messages.subject: getData() issues with very big dataset - problem to retrieve the chromosome id
parts:
Hi Methylkit team!

I am using methylkit with whole genome EMseq. I ran methylkit by C-site as well as by tiles. I have trouble with the getData() function in C-site analysis but not on tiles. In C-sites, I cannot retrieve the chromosome ID. I do not have any error message like memory limitation.

Note that I am saving each step in RDS in case of bugs.

Sorry for the long email.
Thank you for your help !!

Best,
Helene






##########
#    Script   #
##########

meth <- methylKit::unite(
        myobj,
        destrand=FALSE,
        min.per.group = as.integer(min_per_grp),
        save.db = TRUE,
        dbtype = "tabix",
        dbdir = OUTDIR,
        mc.cores = cpu
        )

saveRDS(meth, paste(OUTDIR,'/',contrast_name,'_',context,'_',min_cov,'r_mingrp',min_per_grp,'_unite_sites.rds',sep=''))
saveRDS(getData(meth), paste(OUTDIR,'/',contrast_name,'_',context,'_',min_cov,'r_mingrp',min_per_grp,'_unite_sites_tables.rds',sep='’))



meth <- readRDS(paste(OUTDIR,'/',contrast_name,'_',context,'_',min_cov,'r_mingrp',min_per_grp,'_unite_sites.rds',sep=''))


myDiff <- calculateDiffMeth(
            meth,
            covariates=covariates,
            mc.cores= cpu,
            save.db = TRUE,
            dbtype = "tabix",
            dbdir = OUTDIR
            )

saveRDS(myDiff,
    paste(OUTDIR,'/',contrast_name,'_',context,'_',min_cov,'r_mingrp',min_per_grp,'_covariates_methdiff_sites.rds',sep=''))

saveRDS(getData(myDiff),
    paste(OUTDIR,'/',contrast_name,'_',context,'_',min_cov,'r_mingrp',min_per_grp,'_covariates_methdiff_sites_tables.rds',sep=''))
